description: Seventh release after us-rulespec-2026-09-14-wave4-r2-union: every HTS-numbered line of the USITC HTS 2026 Revision 15 schedule (docs/ingest-runs/2026-09-22-hts-full-schedule-union.md). It selects us/statute/2026-08-09-usitc-hts-2026-rev15-full-schedule in place of us/statute/2026-08-09-rulespec-hts-current-with-legacy-aluminum-and-witnesses; the two share 1,711 citation paths with byte-identical bodies, and the full schedule now serves them. The three 2025 Revision 16 aluminum lines only the replaced scope carried (9903.85.02, 9903.85.08, 9903.85.12) stay served from us/statute/2026-08-01-usitc-hts-2025-rev16-r2026-09-22-legacy-aluminum-self-contained. Every other scope is unchanged.
